info.title: fluentregex - companion tool for Masterly.FluentRegex
info.description: Command-line companion for Masterly.FluentRegex: prove two regexes equivalent, optimize, learn from examples, profile backtracking, measure coverage, export to JavaScript and to the regex dialects of PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server and SQLite, compile to SQL LIKE with a proof of exactness, print proven language facts, convert to fluent C#, scan codebases for ReDoS, generate test data, trace matches and draw railroad diagrams.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: <regex> [--options <list>] [--confirm]

options.name: --options
options.description: Comma-separated RegexOptions, e.g. IgnoreCase,Multiline

options.name: --ascii-digits
options.description: Make \d match only 0-9 (by default .NET's \d matches every Unicode digit)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 findings at or above --fail-on (analyze/scan), 2 usage or input error.

commands.name: compare
commands.description: <regexA> <regexB> [--options <list>] Prove equivalence or show the shortest counterexample

commands.name: convert
commands.description: --file <path>                        Convert every regex literal in C# files

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Report which branches and limits the lines of a file exercise

commands.name: diagram
commands.description: <regex> [--format svg|mermaid] [--output <file>] [--options <list>]

commands.name: explain
commands.description: <regex> [--options <list>]           Explain a regex in plain English

commands.name: export
commands.description: <regex> [--to js|json-schema|typescript|postgresql|mysql|mariadb|sqlserver|sqlite]

commands.name: facts
commands.description: <regex> [--scope full|substring] [--options <list>]

commands.name: learn
commands.description: <example>... [--not <example>...]   Infer a regex from examples (or --from-file <path>, one per line)

commands.name: optimize
commands.description: Simplify a regex with verified, semantics-preserving rewrites

commands.name: profile
commands.description: <regex> <input> [--options <list>]   Count backtracking steps and show the hotspots

commands.name: scan
commands.description: <path> [--fail-on high|medium|none] [--confirm]

commands.name: trace
commands.description: <regex> <input> [--options <list>]   Show which part matched what, or where it failed
